notes.title: The Overhaul has Arrived!
notes.content:
Greetings Miners,
The overhaul for Our Nation's Miner is finally here!

With this re-release, the story of Our Nation's Miner now directly ties into the alternate-reality project called [url=https://wiki.gamedetectives.net/index.php?title=Entropy]Entropy[/url].

Here is the overview from the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/360040/Our_Nations_Miner/]storefront[/url]:

[h1]Welcome to the Empire, Miner![/h1]

It’s 1984, and in the basement of a quiet arcade store somewhere in the UK, an experimental arcade machine is gathering dust.

The headline game: [b]Our Nation’s Miner![/b]
A game that puts the player in the shoes of a synthetic clone, waking up centuries too late into a spacefaring empire that has now been overrun with a peculiar mix of rogue AI.

[b]But not everything is as it seems[/b]. The arcade machine holds dark secrets that need to be uncovered. Be careful not to fall down the [b]rabbit hole[/b]...

[h1]An Evolving Game[/h1]
Our Nation's Miner is an [b]evolving project[/b] which ties into the grand narrative of an alternate-reality game called 'Entropy'. Over time, the game will be [b]expanded and change[/b] in response to player interactions both inside and outside of the application.

[h1]Unfolding Mysteries[/h1]
This is a game with an [b]ever-expanding[/b] collection of [b]hidden features[/b] and [b]secret paths[/b]. Players are encouraged to experiment and [b]be the first[/b] to uncover these mysteries. Their discoveries may change the game forever.


[i]If you would still like to experience the legacy version of Our Nation's Miner, you can do so for free by going to our [url=https://www.lordbytesworth.net/legacy-downloads]website[/url].
